about: Reviewed false positives for the blob checks' credential scan (.githooks/lib.mjs secretProblems). Each entry names one line of one exact blob: its object id, path and 1-based line. Add one only for a value that is public, with the review in why. A real credential is rotated and removed instead, never listed.

entries.why: The wildshard.io zone's Cloudflare Web Analytics site token: public, served in every page the zone injects the beacon into. The scan read const BEACON_TOKEN = '<hex>' as a credential. 945c03774 renamed it, but main dispatch and release history scans still re-read bef3e3273.
